vocabulary.definition: A part of a number found by multiplying the number by the percent written as a decimal.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Una parte de un número que se halla multiplicando el número por el porcentaje escrito como decimal.
vocabulary.cloze: A part found by multiplying a number by a percent in decimal form is the ___ ___ ___ ___.

examples.why: The percent was written as a decimal before multiplying.
Using the percent as a whole number makes it 100 times too big.

vocabulary.definition: A way to compare a number to 100, shown with the % sign.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Una manera de comparar un número con 100, con el signo %.
vocabulary.cloze: A number out of 100 is a ___.

examples.text: 9 out of 100 students walk to school → 9%
examples.why: The comparison is already out of 100.
That is 90%, not 9% — both terms must be scaled to 100.

vocabulary.definition: The whole amount you start with — the number right after the word “of.”
vocabulary.definitionEs: La cantidad total con la que empiezas: el número que va después de la palabra “de”.
vocabulary.cloze: The whole amount you start with, right after the word “of,” is the ___.

examples.why: It is the whole amount, right after the word “of”.

examples.text: The 24 you get as the answer
examples.why: That is the part the percent produced.

vocabulary.definition: How much of the base (the whole) you get. It is your answer.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Cuánto obtienes de la base (el total). Es tu respuesta.
vocabulary.visual: 25% of 80 = 20 → the part is 20 (20 out of the 80).
vocabulary.cloze: The amount you get out of the whole is the ___.

examples.why: It is the piece of the base the percent describes.
That is the base, the whole you started from.

vocabulary.definition: A number sentence with an equal sign. The percent one is: part = percent × base.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Una oración numérica con signo de igual. La de porcentaje es: parte = porcentaje × base.
vocabulary.cloze: A number sentence with an equal sign, like part = percent × base, is an ___.

examples.why: Percent times whole equals part, with the unknown whole as n.
The percent relationship multiplies; it never adds.

vocabulary.definition: Money taken off the first price to make it cheaper.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Dinero que se quita del precio original para que sea más barato.

examples.why: Money taken off the original price.

copyPanel.rule: Finding the Percent of a Number
steps: 1. Identify the percent and the whole (base amount)
2. Convert the percent to a decimal or simplified fraction
3. Multiply the decimal/fraction by the whole to calculate the part

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Book Fair
revealWordProblem.text:
Students were asked which night of the book fair they planned to attend. The results are shown. Then 20% of the students who planned to attend on Wednesday came on Thursday instead, and 25% of the students who planned to attend on Thursday came on Friday instead.
Question: Which day, Thursday or Friday, had the greater actual attendance? How many more students attended that day?
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A Book Fair attendance table: Monday 55 students, Tuesday 80, Wednesday 70, Thursday 112, Friday 65.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: 20% of Wednesday's 70 students is 0.2 × 70 = 14 students who moved to Thursday, so Thursday's group grows to 112 + 14 = 126. Then 25% of the 112 who had planned Thursday is 0.25 × 112 = 28 students who moved to Friday. Thursday's actual attendance is 126 − 28 = 98, and Friday's is 65 + 28 = 93. Thursday was greater, by 98 − 93 = 5 students.

choiceFeedback: Try converting 20% to a decimal or fraction first.
hints: '20% of 150' means you want a PART of 150 — the answer should be smaller than 150.
Convert the percent to a decimal, then multiply: Part = Percent × Base.
Write 20% as 0.20, then set up 0.20 × 150. (Shortcut: 10% of 150 is 15 — double it.)
hintsEs: '20% de 150' significa que quieres una PARTE de 150: la respuesta debe ser menor que 150.
Convierte el porcentaje en decimal y luego multiplica: Parte = Porcentaje × Base.
Escribe 20% como 0.20 y plantea 0.20 × 150. (Atajo: 10% de 150 es 15; duplícalo.)

choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you subtracted 50 from 84. Instead: Multiply: 0.50 × 84 = ___.
hints: 50% is a friendly percent — it means exactly one-half of the number.
Finding 50% of a number is the same as dividing that number by 2.
Set up 84 ÷ 2, or check with the formula: 0.50 × 84.
hintsEs: 50% es un porcentaje amigable: significa exactamente la mitad del número.
Hallar el 50% de un número es lo mismo que dividir ese número entre 2.
Plantea 84 ÷ 2, o compruébalo con la fórmula: 0.50 × 84.

questions.explanation: 10% = 0.10. Multiply: 0.10 × 320 = 32. (Or move the decimal one place left.)
choiceFeedback: 10% is one-tenth — divide 320 by 10 or move the decimal.
hints: 10% means one-tenth — there's a shortcut that needs no multiplication at all.
To find 10% of any number, move the decimal point one place to the left (divide by 10).
Start with 320 and slide the decimal one place left: 320 → what number?
questions.explanationEs: 10% = 0.10. Multiplica: 0.10 × 320 = 32. (O mueve el punto decimal un lugar a la izquierda.)
hintsEs: 10% significa un décimo: hay un atajo que no necesita ninguna multiplicación.
Para hallar el 10% de cualquier número, mueve el punto decimal un lugar a la izquierda (divide entre 10).
Empieza con 320 y desliza el punto un lugar a la izquierda: 320 → ¿qué número?

reviewHighlights.rule: Finding the Percent of a Number
steps: 1. Identify the percent and the whole (base amount)
2. Convert the percent to a decimal or simplified fraction
3. Multiply the decimal/fraction by the whole to calculate the part
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Find the Percent of a Number is multiplying by the percent number itself instead of its decimal form — for example, finding 30% of 80 by computing 30 × 80 = 2,400 instead of 0.30 × 80 = 24. Always divide the percent by 100 to get the decimal, then multiply that decimal by the base.

hints: Put 100% and 26 in the first column. What do you divide 100 by to get 50?
hintsEs: Pon 100% y 26 en la primera columna. ¿Entre cuánto divides 100 para obtener 50?
level1.explanation: Write 100% and the whole in the first column: 100% : 26 Find the scale factor from 100% to 50%: 100 ÷ 50 = 2 Divide the whole by 2 too: 26 ÷ 2 = 13
level1.explanationEs: Escribe 100% y el entero en la primera columna: 100% : 26 Halla el factor de escala de 100% a 50%: 100 ÷ 50 = 2 Divide el entero entre 2 también: 26 ÷ 2 = 13

level1.stem: A book costs $20. It is 10% off. How many dollars do you save?
level1.stemEs: Un libro cuesta $20. Tiene 10% de descuento. ¿Cuántos dólares ahorras?
hints: Put 100% and 20 in the first column. What do you divide 100 by to get 10?
hintsEs: Pon 100% y 20 en la primera columna. ¿Entre cuánto divides 100 para obtener 10?
level1.explanation: Write 100% and the whole in the first column: 100% : 20 Find the scale factor from 100% to 10%: 100 ÷ 10 = 10 Divide the whole by 10 too: 20 ÷ 10 = 2
level1.explanationEs: Escribe 100% y el entero en la primera columna: 100% : 20 Halla el factor de escala de 100% a 10%: 100 ÷ 10 = 10 Divide el entero entre 10 también: 20 ÷ 10 = 2

hints: Put 100% and 24 in the first column. Find 25% first. Then multiply to reach 75%.
hintsEs: Pon 100% y 24 en la primera columna. Halla primero el 25%. Luego multiplica hasta llegar al 75%.
level1.explanation: Write 100% and the whole in the first column: 100% : 24 Divide both by 4 to find 25%: 24 ÷ 4 = 6 Multiply both by 3 to reach 75%: 6 × 3 = 18
level1.explanationEs: Escribe 100% y el entero en la primera columna: 100% : 24 Divide los dos entre 4 para hallar el 25%: 24 ÷ 4 = 6 Multiplica los dos por 3 para llegar al 75%: 6 × 3 = 18

hints: Put 100% and 64 in the first column. What do you divide 100 by to get 50?
hintsEs: Pon 100% y 64 en la primera columna. ¿Entre cuánto divides 100 para obtener 50?
level1.explanation: Write 100% and the whole in the first column: 100% : 64 Find the scale factor from 100% to 50%: 100 ÷ 50 = 2 Divide the whole by 2 too: 64 ÷ 2 = 32
level1.explanationEs: Escribe 100% y el entero en la primera columna: 100% : 64 Halla el factor de escala de 100% a 50%: 100 ÷ 50 = 2 Divide el entero entre 2 también: 64 ÷ 2 = 32

hints: Put 100% and 80 in the first column. Find 5% first. Then multiply to reach 15%.
hintsEs: Pon 100% y 80 en la primera columna. Halla primero el 5%. Luego multiplica hasta llegar al 15%.
level1.explanation: Write 100% and the whole in the first column: 100% : 80 Divide both by 20 to find 5%: 80 ÷ 20 = 4 Multiply both by 3 to reach 15%: 4 × 3 = 12
level1.explanationEs: Escribe 100% y el entero en la primera columna: 100% : 80 Divide los dos entre 20 para hallar el 5%: 80 ÷ 20 = 4 Multiplica los dos por 3 para llegar al 15%: 4 × 3 = 12

level2.stem: Theo says 40% of 50 is 2,000, because 40 × 50 = 2,000. What is 40% of 50?
level2.stemEs: Theo dice que el 40% de 50 es 2,000, porque 40 × 50 = 2,000. ¿Cuánto es el 40% de 50?
hints: 100% matches 50, so 40% must be less than 50. Find 20% first, then double it.
hintsEs: El 100% va con 50, así que el 40% debe ser menor que 50. Halla primero el 20% y luego duplícalo.
level2.explanation: Write 100% and the whole in the first column: 100% : 50 Divide both by 5 to find 20%: 50 ÷ 5 = 10 Multiply both by 2 to reach 40%: 10 × 2 = 20
level2.explanationEs: Escribe 100% y el entero en la primera columna: 100% : 50 Divide los dos entre 5 para hallar el 20%: 50 ÷ 5 = 10 Multiplica los dos por 2 para llegar al 40%: 10 × 2 = 20

hints: Put 100% and 260 in the first column. Find 5% first. Then multiply to reach 35%.
hintsEs: Pon 100% y 260 en la primera columna. Halla primero el 5%. Luego multiplica hasta llegar al 35%.
level2.explanation: Write 100% and the whole in the first column: 100% : 260 Divide both by 20 to find 5%: 260 ÷ 20 = 13 Multiply both by 7 to reach 35%: 13 × 7 = 91
level2.explanationEs: Escribe 100% y el entero en la primera columna: 100% : 260 Divide los dos entre 20 para hallar el 5%: 260 ÷ 20 = 13 Multiplica los dos por 7 para llegar al 35%: 13 × 7 = 91

hints: Put 100% and 35 in the first column. What do you divide 100 by to get 20?
hintsEs: Pon 100% y 35 en la primera columna. ¿Entre cuánto divides 100 para obtener 20?
level2.explanation: Write 100% and the whole in the first column: 100% : 35 Find the scale factor from 100% to 20%: 100 ÷ 20 = 5 Divide the whole by 5 too: 35 ÷ 5 = 7
level2.explanationEs: Escribe 100% y el entero en la primera columna: 100% : 35 Halla el factor de escala de 100% a 20%: 100 ÷ 20 = 5 Divide el entero entre 5 también: 35 ÷ 5 = 7

level2.stem: How much more is 20% of 150 than 25% of 100?
level2.stemEs: ¿Cuánto más es el 20% de 150 que el 25% de 100?
hints: Put 100%, 150 and 100 in the first column. Find 5% of each, then scale up. Subtract the two parts.
hintsEs: Pon 100%, 150 y 100 en la primera columna. Halla el 5% de cada uno y luego multiplica. Resta las dos partes.
level2.explanation: Write 100% and both wholes in the first column: 100% : 150 : 100 Find 20% of 150: divide by 5: 150 ÷ 5 = 30 Find 25% of 100: divide by 4: 100 ÷ 4 = 25 Subtract the parts: 30 − 25 = 5
level2.explanationEs: Escribe 100% y los dos enteros en la primera columna: 100% : 150 : 100 Halla el 20% de 150: divide entre 5: 150 ÷ 5 = 30 Halla el 25% de 100: divide entre 4: 100 ÷ 4 = 25 Resta las partes: 30 − 25 = 5

buildFigure.caption: Read 20% of 150 and 25% of 100.
buildFigure.captionEs: Lee el 20% de 150 y el 25% de 100.

level2.stem: A bus has 48 seats. 25% of the seats are empty. How many seats are empty?
level2.stemEs: Un autobús tiene 48 asientos. El 25% de los asientos está vacío. ¿Cuántos asientos están vacíos?
hints: Put 100% and 48 in the first column. What do you divide 100 by to get 25?
hintsEs: Pon 100% y 48 en la primera columna. ¿Entre cuánto divides 100 para obtener 25?
level2.explanation: Write 100% and the whole in the first column: 100% : 48 Find the scale factor from 100% to 25%: 100 ÷ 25 = 4 Divide the whole by 4 too: 48 ÷ 4 = 12
level2.explanationEs: Escribe 100% y el entero en la primera columna: 100% : 48 Halla el factor de escala de 100% a 25%: 100 ÷ 25 = 4 Divide el entero entre 4 también: 48 ÷ 4 = 12

level3.stem: At West Middle School, 45% of the 360 sixth-grade students participate in after-school sports. How many sixth-grade students participate in sports?
choiceFeedback: That is 40% of 360. Multiply by the actual rate: 0.45 x 360.
That is an estimate rather than the exact product. 0.45 x 360 comes to 162.
That is 50% of 360. The rate is 45%, a little less than half.

level3.stem: Ali finds 15% of 70 as 10% plus 5%. Bea finds 5% and multiplies by 3. Do they get the same answer? What is 15% of 70?
level3.stemEs: Ali halla el 15% de 70 como 10% más 5%. Bea halla el 5% y multiplica por 3. ¿Obtienen la misma respuesta? ¿Cuánto es el 15% de 70?
hints: Put 100% and 70 in the first column. Find 10%, then halve it for 5%.
hintsEs: Pon 100% y 70 en la primera columna. Halla el 10% y luego divídelo entre 2 para el 5%.
level3.explanation: Divide both by 10 to find 10%: 70 ÷ 10 = 7 Divide both by 2 to find 5%: 7 ÷ 2 = 3.5 Ali's way: add 10% and 5%: 7 + 3.5 = 10.5 Bea's way: multiply 5% by 3: 3.5 × 3 = 10.5
level3.explanationEs: Divide los dos entre 10 para hallar el 10%: 70 ÷ 10 = 7 Divide los dos entre 2 para hallar el 5%: 7 ÷ 2 = 3.5 La forma de Ali: suma el 10% y el 5%: 7 + 3.5 = 10.5 La forma de Bea: multiplica el 5% por 3: 3.5 × 3 = 10.5

buildFigure.caption: Ali's way: 10% and 5% in one table.
buildFigure.captionEs: La forma de Ali: 10% y 5% en una tabla.

hints: Put 100% and 60 in the first column. Find 5% first. Then multiply to reach 85%.
hintsEs: Pon 100% y 60 en la primera columna. Halla primero el 5%. Luego multiplica hasta llegar al 85%.
level3.explanation: Write 100% and the whole in the first column: 100% : 60 Divide both by 20 to find 5%: 60 ÷ 20 = 3 Multiply both by 17 to reach 85%: 3 × 17 = 51
level3.explanationEs: Escribe 100% y el entero en la primera columna: 100% : 60 Divide los dos entre 20 para hallar el 5%: 60 ÷ 20 = 3 Multiplica los dos por 17 para llegar al 85%: 3 × 17 = 51

level3.stem: Shop A sells a $25 shirt with 8% tax. Shop B sells a $30 shirt with 6% tax. How many dollars more tax does the shirt at Shop A have?
level3.stemEs: La tienda A vende una camisa de $25 con 8% de impuesto. La tienda B vende una camisa de $30 con 6% de impuesto. ¿Cuántos dólares más de impuesto tiene la camisa de la tienda A?
hints: Put 100%, $25 and $30 in the first column. Find 2% of each first. Then scale up and subtract.
hintsEs: Pon 100%, $25 y $30 en la primera columna. Halla primero el 2% de cada uno. Luego multiplica y resta.
level3.explanation: Divide both prices by 50 to find 2%: 25 ÷ 50 = 0.5; 30 ÷ 50 = 0.6 Multiply by 4 for Shop A's 8%: 0.5 × 4 = 2 Multiply by 3 for Shop B's 6%: 0.6 × 3 = 1.8 Subtract the taxes: 2 − 1.8 = 0.2
level3.explanationEs: Divide los dos precios entre 50 para hallar el 2%: 25 ÷ 50 = 0.5; 30 ÷ 50 = 0.6 Multiplica por 4 para el 8% de la tienda A: 0.5 × 4 = 2 Multiplica por 3 para el 6% de la tienda B: 0.6 × 3 = 1.8 Resta los impuestos: 2 − 1.8 = 0.2

buildFigure.caption: Read 8% for Shop A and 6% for Shop B.
buildFigure.captionEs: Lee el 8% para la tienda A y el 6% para la tienda B.

level3.stem: A school has 80 students. 45% of them play a sport. 25% of those players are on the soccer team. How many students are on the soccer team?
level3.stemEs: Una escuela tiene 80 estudiantes. El 45% practica un deporte. El 25% de esos jugadores está en el equipo de fútbol. ¿Cuántos estudiantes están en el equipo de fútbol?
hints: Use a table to find the players. Then the players are the new 100% in a second table.
hintsEs: Usa una tabla para hallar los jugadores. Luego los jugadores son el nuevo 100% en una segunda tabla.
level3.explanation: Divide 100% : 80 by 20 to find 5%: 80 ÷ 20 = 4 Multiply by 9 to reach 45%: 4 × 9 = 36 New table: 100% : 36. Divide by 4: 36 ÷ 4 = 9
level3.explanationEs: Divide 100% : 80 entre 20 para hallar el 5%: 80 ÷ 20 = 4 Multiplica por 9 para llegar al 45%: 4 × 9 = 36 Tabla nueva: 100% : 36. Divide entre 4: 36 ÷ 4 = 9

buildFigure.caption: Then make a new table: the players are 100%.
buildFigure.captionEs: Luego haz una tabla nueva: los jugadores son el 100%.
